shorts_extract.hook: Seven clangs of a steel bar behind an 11-month-old infant launched emotional conditioning — and a century of textbook myths, detective hunts, and ethics reform.
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Watson & Rayner (1920): fearless 9-month baseline to 7 rat + steel-bar pairings to fur generalization vs wooden-block control.
shorts_extract.twist: Why textbooks hid fading fear, why Watson never cured Albert, Mary Cover Jones's 1924 'Little Peter' exposure cure, and the Barger vs Merritte archival mystery.
